findings.evidenceJa: 一際、甲高い響き
findings.governingReading: an exceptionally high-pitched resonance
findings.explanation: The sound’s distinction from what preceded it is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 白刃
findings.governingReading: the white blade
findings.explanation: The blade’s moonlit whiteness is replaced by an unsupported state of being drawn.

findings.highlight: The brilliant moonlight glints off the drawn sword as it clatters to the stairs
findings.evidenceJa: 玲瓏たる月光を受け、光を散りばめながら転がり落ちていく
findings.governingReading: receiving limpid moonlight, the blade tumbles down scattering points of light
findings.explanation: The sustained visual movement and scattered light are replaced by one glint and a clatter.

findings.highlight: His arms are the next to fall
findings.evidenceJa: その長刀は、二度と拾い上げられる事はない
findings.governingReading: the long sword will never be picked up again
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts the source-free bodily event that Assassin’s arms fall.

findings.evidenceJa: 壮絶な朱の華
findings.governingReading: a terrible, magnificent scarlet flower
findings.explanation: Emotional intensity and scarlet color become unsupported physical size and generic red.

findings.evidenceJa: 蛇蠍魔蠍の類
findings.governingReading: of the snake, scorpion, or demonic-scorpion kind
findings.explanation: The compound category of abhorrent crawling creatures is narrowed to serpents.

findings.evidenceJa: 鮮血に染まった腹
findings.governingReading: his abdomen stained with fresh blood
findings.explanation: The specific site and fresh blood are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 唇は白蝋
findings.governingReading: his lips are white wax
findings.explanation: The deathly wax image is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 喉元よりせりあがる悪寒も既にない
findings.governingReading: the chill rising from his throat is already gone
findings.explanation: A vanished internal chill is replaced by mutually conditional claims that breath or blood no longer passes through his throat.

findings.highlight: internal organs no longer serve their original purpose
findings.evidenceJa: 内臓は、もはや別のモノとして機能している
findings.governingReading: his organs now function as something else
findings.explanation: Active alien repurposing is weakened to loss of original function.

findings.evidenceJa: 次元の違うモノ
findings.governingReading: a thing belonging to a different dimension
findings.explanation: Ontological difference is reduced to comparative strength.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が割れる
findings.governingReading: body splits apart
findings.explanation: A splitting transformation is replaced with an explosive burst.

findings.evidenceJa: 胴を裂かれ
findings.governingReading: his torso torn open
findings.explanation: The classic conditional adds generalized mutilation and omits the torso.

findings.evidenceJa: 長刀を持つ事もならない
findings.governingReading: unable even to hold his long sword
findings.explanation: Physical incapacity is changed into possession of no weapon.

findings.evidenceJa: ヒタヒタと歩く
findings.governingReading: the shadow walks with soft, pattering steps
findings.explanation: The uncanny sound and motion of the approach disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 愛しそうに、或いは蔑むように
findings.governingReading: as though lovingly, or perhaps contemptuously
findings.explanation: Deliberately unresolved opposite readings are fused into one contradictory gesture.

findings.evidenceJa: 骨が絡む
findings.governingReading: bones intertwine
findings.explanation: Transformation through entanglement becomes breakage.

findings.highlight: his organs are turning into someone else’s
findings.evidenceJa: 五臓六腑、自分のモノであったモノが、まったく別の何者かの内臓に変わっていく
findings.governingReading: all his viscera, what had been his own, turn into the organs of an entirely different being
findings.explanation: The exhaustive bodily inventory, prior ownership, and radical otherness are reduced.

findings.evidenceJa: 逆流する血堰を押し留める
findings.governingReading: holds back the reverse-flowing dam of blood
findings.explanation: The hydraulic image and force of the blood are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 涼やかな唇のまま笑み
findings.governingReading: smiles with his lips still cool and composed
findings.explanation: Kojirou’s composed elegance is confused with the waxen pallor described earlier.

findings.evidenceJa: 自決を許されず
findings.governingReading: denied even suicide
findings.explanation: The specific denial of self-killing is moralized as loss of an honorable death.

findings.highlight: He smiles, even though he is denied an honorable death
findings.evidenceJa: その血肉を蝕まれてなお微笑む
findings.governingReading: he smiles even while his flesh and blood are being consumed
findings.explanation: The ongoing consumption of Kojirou’s body is omitted.

findings.highlight: His smile is grander than the spawning of this abomination
findings.evidenceJa: その笑みこそが、この異形の生誕を上回る凄絶さ
findings.governingReading: that smile is more ghastly and overwhelming than the abomination’s birth
findings.explanation: Horror and extremity are mistranslated as grandeur.

findings.highlight: Taking the false Servant’s flesh as its own, the true Assassin enters our world
findings.evidenceJa: 偽りのサーヴァントを血肉とし、その臓腑よりこの世に現れたモノは、紛れもない“暗殺者”のサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: using the false Servant as flesh and blood, what emerges from his viscera is unmistakably a Servant of the Assassin class
findings.explanation: The birth from Kojirou’s organs and class identification are reduced, while “true” is inserted as an unexplained label.

findings.highlight: devours the body that was his own nursery
findings.evidenceJa: その苗床を貪り尽くす
findings.governingReading: devours completely the host body that served as its seedbed
findings.explanation: The seedbed is Kojirou’s body for the emerging creature; the possessive English makes ownership ambiguous.

findings.evidenceJa: ケラケラと引き裂き、ゲラゲラと噛み砕く
findings.governingReading: cackling as it tears apart, guffawing as it chews to pieces
findings.explanation: Conditional line assembly leaves incomplete English actions without objects.

findings.highlight: the insect becomes more like a man
findings.evidenceJa: 黒虫は人のカタチを成し
findings.governingReading: the black insect takes human form
findings.explanation: A completed acquisition of human shape becomes gradual resemblance.

findings.evidenceJa: そうして半刻
findings.governingReading: and so, after half a koku
findings.explanation: A specific approximately hour-long duration is generalized.

findings.highlight: finished sipping every last bit of the blood
findings.evidenceJa: 何もかも綺麗に啜り上げ、石段には跡形もなく
findings.governingReading: sipped up everything cleanly, leaving no trace on the stone steps
findings.explanation: Total consumption and the absence of any trace are narrowed to finishing blood.

findings.highlight: the chorus of insects and the shining moonlight
findings.evidenceJa: 草陰で合唱する蟲の群と、浩々と輝く月輪
findings.governingReading: the swarm of insects chorusing in the grass and the vast, shining disc of the moon
findings.explanation: Location, collectivity, scale, and the concrete moon disc are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 高みへ消えていく
findings.governingReading: disappears upward into the heights as though melting
findings.explanation: The cry’s upward direction is replaced by darkness.

findings.highlight: A white skull laughs under the black-burned sky
findings.evidenceJa: 黒焦げの空に、白い髑髏が嗤っていた
findings.governingReading: a white skull sneers in the charred-black sky
findings.explanation: The skull’s position within the sky and the jeering quality of its expression are altered.
